title: Hezion
summary: Raleigh names Hezion in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Hezion, King of Aram at Damascus, grandfather of Benhadad who inuaded Baasha, and in league with Asa. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XI, §. II, sig. 253b
